symptoms.question: Do you hear clunking or knocking noises from the suspension when driving over bumps? (yes/no)
Does the steering wheel feel loose with free play before the wheels respond? (yes/no)
Does the steering feel heavier than usual, especially at low speeds? (yes/no)
When driving in a straight line on a level road, does the car pull to one side? (yes/no)

rules.diagnosis: Noises over bumps suggest worn suspension bushes or joints.
rules.advice: Worn suspension parts can affect handling and tyre wear. Have the suspension inspected.

rules.diagnosis: Loose steering with free play can indicate worn steering links or rack.
rules.advice: Loose steering reduces control of the vehicle. Have the steering system checked soon.

rules.diagnosis: Heavy steering without vibration can indicate a power steering pump, belt, or fluid problem.
rules.advice: Check the power steering fluid level and have the system inspected if the problem persists.

rules.diagnosis: Pulling in a straight line is often caused by wheel alignment or tyre pressure differences.
rules.advice: Check tyre pressures and ask for an alignment check at the next opportunity.
